_comment: Optional. Copy to syllabus.json. Deliverables named in a syllabus that the LMS doesn't list yet, keyed by course code. Rows are [title, kind (assignment|quiz|exam|other), due (ISO 8601 with offset), match, options?]. Once the LMS lists an assignment in that course whose title matches the case-insensitive regex `match`, the row is hidden, so the LMS stays the source of truth. Options: {"inPerson": true} for things done in class (exams, in-class quizzes, presentations): once their time passes they count as done instead of 'past due'.
